def transform(grid):
    import random
    from collections import Counter
    n=len(grid)
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    colors=list(counts)
    weights=[counts[c] for c in colors]
    seed=sum((i+1)*(j+3)*v for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row))
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    out=[[rng.choices(colors,weights=weights,k=1)[0] for _ in range(2*n)] for _ in range(2*n)]
    for i in range(n): out[i][:n]=grid[i][:]
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    import random
    from collections import Counter
    n=len(grid)
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    colors=list(counts)
    weights=[counts[c] for c in colors]
    seed=sum((i+1)*(j+3)*v for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row))
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    out=[[rng.choices(colors,weights=weights,k=1)[0] for _ in range(2*n)] for _ in range(2*n)]
    for i in range(n): out[i][:n]=grid[i][:]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    import random
    n=len(grid)
    palette=sorted(set(v for row in grid for v in row))
    seed=sum((i*31+j*17+1)*v for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row))
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    out=[[rng.choice(palette) for _ in range(2*n)] for _ in range(2*n)]
    for i in range(n): out[i][:n]=grid[i][:]
    return out
